## Definition of done

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build` pass locally and in CI
- [ ] Spec exists under `specs/` with Given/When/Then criteria and matches the implementation
- [ ] Data rules hold: no secrets, no Zoom links, no raw transcripts, fixtures are public fields only
- [ ] UI changes checked on the Cloudflare preview (n/a for docs-only PRs)
- [ ] One human review from someone who is not the author
